defects.status: Resolved technically in MSR-02; owner performance review pending
defects.title: Jesse instruction and David listening settle into long held poses
defects.reproduce: Follow the automatic messenger/path/arrival, Speak to Jesse, then watch jesse-provisions through its middle and end.
defects.observed: Jesse sampled-joint hold about 8.91 seconds; David about 7.03 seconds during a 9.579-second line. Captured at normal clocks.
defects.acceptance: Natural instruction/listening beats without accidental long end-pose holds; same messenger, arrival, Speak/Take and checkpoint order.

resolution.observed: Jesse completes pointing/rest/second pointing; David continues listening. No multi-second exact body hold reproduced in any tested layout.

defects.status: Resolved technically in MSR-02; owner performance review pending
defects.title: Keeper and Eliab speech outlasts their speaking gestures
defects.reproduce: Deliver provisions, watch directions-keeper, then greet brothers and watch answer-eliab.
defects.observed: 3.208-second speak_concern reaches its end; keeper hold 1.56 seconds, Eliab contiguous hold 1.87 seconds while their lines continue.
defects.acceptance: Both complete exchanges sustain appropriate motion and preserve carry/prop contact and independent delivery/greeting saves.

resolution.observed: Keeper and Eliab sustain forward gestures across their full long lines; both camp objectives complete once and the basket release/carry remain working.

defects.status: Resolved technically in MSR-04/05; owner journey presentation review pending
defects.title: Five inter-location links lack a player walking connection
defects.reproduce: Use the normal chapter progression from survey to camp, brothers to challenge, Eliab to Saul, armour refusal to brook and practice to battle.
defects.observed: Chapter buttons/new entry scenes or immediate covered root transfer supply the connection. No player departure bridges those locations.
defects.acceptance: R07 pilot first; then brief obstacle-valid guided departures/arrivals, without new objectives, lost save state or exposed relocation.

resolution.retainedPilot: R07 implemented and verified in MSR-04; retained in the fresh normal journey.

defects.status: Resolved technically in MSR-06; owner performance/listening review pending
defects.title: David's faith response outlasts the expressive part of its clip
defects.reproduce: Enter Chapter 5, approach Goliath and watch david-faith near its end.
defects.observed: The 5.888-second response outlasts a 4.417-second clip. Matched one-second samples (10 frames each) vary by about 6.27 degrees earlier and 0.77 degrees near the end. This is not an exact all-joints freeze claim.
defects.acceptance: A reviewed sustained response/return while preserving every existing combat timing, stage and aftermath rule.

resolution.observed: Final desktop late one-second joint excursion 4.130° versus 0.434° in the fresh MSR-05 baseline; forward-fitted gesture covers the 6.019-second same-word/same-cast recording. All original confrontation/physical combat timings retained.

defects.status: Resolved technically in MSR-04/05: contextual camp and challenge cinematic/movement hints
defects.title: Movement hints remain visible during non-playable dialogue
defects.reproduce: Start a camp dialogue or Goliath's challenge and read the footer while the owned cinematic runs.
defects.observed: WASD/arrows, look and interact hints remain although the sequence has intentionally disabled those controls.
defects.acceptance: Watch/Pause cues while cinematic; accurate movement hints return with control in desktop and both touch orientations.

partialResolution.observed: Chapter 3 footer switches to Watch/Pause during arrival, challenge, exchange and transfer; returns to movement hints on the guided departure.

defects.title: Audience David voice emitter remained behind his settled speaking position
defects.observed: Baseline actual browser graph and positions showed a 2.15 m planar mismatch during the response.
defects.resolution: Pilot audience uses an opt-in centered dialogue bus; actual voice paths contain no PannerNode, while other scene mixes retain defaults.

defects.resolution: Forward line fitting and a recording-derived one-shot reaction score; final core traces record zero reverse steps and zero guard resets.

defects.title: Goliath’s staged voice emitter stayed at the pre-entrance position
defects.status: Resolved technically and browser verified in MSR-06; owner presentation review pending

defects.title: Victory audio startup had no deadline/retry recovery
defects.status: Resolved and browser verified in MSR-07
defects.observed: Standalone profiles timed out without an established platform cause. Separately, an injected non-resolving AudioContext.resume reproduced Begin disabled beyond 9.2 seconds; the source awaited indefinitely.

resolution.change: Existing eight-second resume helper, start guard, paused old timeline, cue cancellation, visible retry and rejection handling. Late request completion cannot replay the scene.

unverifiedOrDecisionItems.status: Owner confirmed latest previews not yet reviewed on 20 November
unverifiedOrDecisionItems.item: MSR-03 provides three directed David/Saul takes and MSR-06 one David faith response with the same casts and words. Owner listening must judge intonation, pace and naturalness; output/morph data cannot approve them.
Two waveform-driven mouth shapes do not establish phoneme-specific lip sync; extra facial morphs require a separate decision.

unverifiedOrDecisionItems.status: Not established as a game defect
unverifiedOrDecisionItems.item: Instrumented 1116.9/628.9 ms frame gaps are confounded by capture. Two clean armour-refusal probes peaked at 29.8/27.8 ms. No shader/logic cause assigned.

unverifiedOrDecisionItems.status: Local browser input measured; formal planted-sole acceptance remains open
unverifiedOrDecisionItems.item: Eighteen final-build trusted browser event-to-rendered-root trials measured 4.4–29.9 ms. This is not physical input-to-photon certification. Earlier ankle-proxy movement included about 9.1 cm; actual sole contact within the proposed 8 cm across starts/stops, pivots and terrain is unverified.

unverifiedOrDecisionItems.status: Modest variation implemented/verified in MSR-06; owner preference review pending
unverifiedOrDecisionItems.item: Existing crowd instances now stagger cheer/rest beats, and the foreground soldier listens during the conclusion. The distant crowd still uses three economical baked cheer poses; further art/rig scope is a separate decision.

Automated tab probing did not establish trusted visibility events/audio suspension. Windows Computer Use stopped at the new-tab action because the current browser URL could not be determined confidently. Regular Chrome tab-away/return during the reply remains a manual check; no app input continued after the block.
Owner confirmed on 20 November that no unaided first-time player is available; prepared task sheet awaits an actual session.
Opening cold loading varies; paired medians 9512/9507 ms did not reproduce the initial >10% regression. Hosted-network startup budget and minimum-phone performance are not approved or certified.
